title: FP8/INT8 probe-chain and cross-quant validation for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Build an end-to-end probe-chain and synthetic-to-production validation workflow that enables FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) profiles on Hopper GPUs while preserving model quality vs FP32 and ensuring safe rollouts. Deliverables include: a layered probe harness (synthetic microprobes -> shadow batches -> canary), cross-quant interop checks between FP8 and INT8, divergence detectors for automatic gating, CI gating for golden prompt suites, and an operational rollback heuristic tied to telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Quantized FP8 profiles (E4M3 and E5M2) pass the golden-prompt regression suite with <=1.0% relative delta in BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics vs FP32 baseline for chat/generation tasks
Token-level distribution drift measured by KL divergence under probe-chain remains below configured thresholds for 95% of runs
Canary traffic rollout script can automatically pause and rollback a profile when the rolling 30-minute regression count exceeds threshold
Telemetry exposes per-layer outlier rates, per-op quantization saturation counters, and end-to-end cost/latency delta; dashboards created and linked
No customer-facing errors increase by more than 0.5% during a staged rollout (measured on shadow traffic)
notes: This work complements the continuous calibration service but focuses on an empirically driven probe sequence that is reproducible across CI and prod canaries.
We intentionally include INT8 cross-checks to detect modes where FP8 produces subtle sequence-level regressions even if token statistics look similar.
Key metrics will be sampled at three levels: microprobe (synthetic single-batch), shadow (small real-traffic samples), and canary (low-percentage traffic).
Plan to reuse existing telemetry channels:
tasks: Design probe-chain stages and failure semantics (owner: Michael Chen)
Implement synthetic microprobe generator with deterministic seeds and per-layer stress patterns (owner: Priya Rao)
Extend calibration runner to emit per-op saturation and dynamic range histograms (owner: Simon Lee)
Create cross-quant interop harness to run FP32/FP8/INT8 pipelines and compute divergence metrics (owner: Darryl Mendez)
Instrument runtime gating that listens to divergence signals and flips profile selection to safe default
Compose CI gate that runs golden suite and blocks merges on regression
Dashboard + alerting: build visualizations and on-call runbook
Bake rollout jobs into the deployment pipeline with staged percentages and automatic rollback
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created. Initial proposal reviewed in weekly quantization sync. Agreed to include INT8 interop as guard.
2026-02-25: Microprobe spec drafted. Michael to pair with Priya on deterministic seed selection. Decided metric set: KL, token perplexity, and sequence F1 for retrieval tasks.
2026-03-02: First synthetic microprobe runs show layer-6 activation saturation in E4M3 on long-sequence prompts; added per-layer hysteresis threshold to mitigate flapping.

2026-03-06: Darryl landed cross-quant harness prototype. Initial INT8 vs FP8 agreement check flagged 12/200 test prompts with sequence-level drift > 2% despite token-level KL < 0.005. Those prompts added to the golden suite.
2026-03-10: Telemetry scaffolding merged to staging. Dashboard placeholders created. Next: run shadow batches for 24h to collect production-like statistics.
rollback_plan: Immediate: runtime gate flips profile to FP32 baseline for the affected model shard
Short-term: pause rollout and mark profile as blocked in the catalog
Follow-up: capture failing prompts, open regression bug with stack traces and per-layer histograms, run targeted calibration retrain or widen dynamic range as necessary
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: FP8 shows latent sequence-level regressions not visible in microprobes. Mitigation: increase shadow sample diversity and add sequence-level scoring to probes.
Risk: Telemetry volume impacts performance. Mitigation: sample aggressively and aggregate histograms on-agent before upload.
Risk: Canary spikes cause customer-visible latency. Mitigation: cap canary CPU/GPU footprint and monitor SLA closely; auto-fallback enabled.
estimated_costs: engineering: ~2 sprint-weeks of core eng + 1 sprint-week of oncall triage; infra: small telemetry storage increase (~50GB/month)
qa_plan: Run microprobe suite in CI on each PR
